headline: Botox Maker Tops Buy Point, But Here Comes The Earnings Report
summary: AbbVie closed above the 230.47 buy point from a cup-with-handle base on June 23 and has climbed 15% from there.  The previous day, the stock jumped more than 6% after AbbVie announced it agreed to acquire Apogee Therapeutics.  The $10.9 billion deal would strengthen AbbVie's immunology pipeline.
